title: Resetting internet banking password using mobile OTP
sample_queries: I forgot my internet banking password
How do I reset my password?
I can't log in to my account
My password isn't working, help me change it
overview: Guides the user through resetting their NetBanking password online using their registered mobile number, the fastest of the available methods since it needs no branch visit.

steps.instruction: Go to the NetBanking login page and click on 'Forgot Password'.
Enter your customer ID and the security code shown on screen, then continue.
Enter the mobile number registered with your account and continue.
You'll receive an OTP on that number — enter it on the screen.
Choose your verification method — either mobile number with debit card details, or mobile number with email ID — and enter the requested details.
Set your new password and confirm it. You should see a success message once it's done, and you can log in right away.

notes: If the user doesn't have access to their registered mobile number, offer the alternative of authenticating through PhoneBanking or visiting a branch instead — don't continue with the OTP flow in that case.

title: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
sample_queries: My account is locked, I tried logging in too many times
It says too many failed attempts, what do I do?
I'm locked out of my banking app
answer: A lockout after repeated failed attempts is a standard security measure, not a sign anything's wrong with your account. You can unlock it the same way you'd reset a forgotten password — through the 'Forgot Password' option using your registered mobile number and OTP. If that doesn't resolve it, calling PhoneBanking or visiting a branch will also clear the lock.

title: Resetting password without access to registered mobile number
sample_queries: I lost my phone and can't get the OTP
I don't have my registered number anymore, how do I reset my password?
What if I can't receive the OTP?
answer: If you no longer have access to your registered mobile number, you have two options: authenticate through PhoneBanking by calling in and verifying your identity with a representative, or visit a nearby branch with valid ID to request your password be regenerated and sent to your registered address. Either way, you'll want to update your registered mobile number afterward so future resets go smoothly.

title: Why NetBanking password expired
sample_queries: Why is it asking me to reset my password, I didn't forget it
It says my password needs to be changed
answer: For security, NetBanking passwords expire automatically after 180 days. When that happens, you'll see a prompt to reset it the next time you log in — just click Reset Password on that prompt, set a new one, and confirm. It's a routine security refresh, not a sign of anything wrong with your account.

title: Changing your password while already logged in
sample_queries: I know my password but want to change it, how?
How do I change my NetBanking password without resetting it?
I want to update my IPIN while I'm logged in
answer: If you already know your current password and just want to change it, that's different from a forgot-password reset — you can do it by going to the hamburger menu and selecting Change Password, then following the change-password transaction from there.
